notes.title: Visual Novel Game Fest and collaboration bundle with S4U
notes.content:
Hey, our friends!

We are thrilled to announce that Minds Beneath Us is participating in Visual Novel Game Fest!

Besides, we are honored to reveal a special collaboration bundle: S4U x Minds Beneath Us, featuring Minds Beneath Us and S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH — two narrative-driven games set in the cyberpunk-inspired, near-future Asian universe.

Please check out this bundle [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50551/ style=button]here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40422901/af6e0a93ab7c802547e867416a0b6e6ebced573a.jpg[/img]

If you haven't yet experienced these titles, seize this opportunity to purchase the bundle at an additional discounted price. Dive into two distinct perspectives that explore humanity's struggles and resilience beneath the tides of cybernetic upheaval.

About S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH

Step into 2011's Castor Yard as Miki, a part-time “digital avatar”, navigating life, love, and belonging through chat windows.

[list]
[*] Innovative keyboard interaction: Experience the rhythm of survival in the digital age through real-time typing mechanics.
[*] Multi-threaded life simulation: From convenience store meals to rooftop heart-to-hearts, over 200 events weave a vivid urban tapestry.
[*] 20+ character bonds: Forge connections with AI beings, hackers, and convenience store clerks to craft your own memoir of Castor Yard.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50551

notes.title: 1000 Reviews! And a small update
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support! Our game, Minds Beneath Us, has now received 1,000 reviews on Steam, with a 96% positive rating. We are incredibly grateful for your love of our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40422901/33c70ca68e9d46ef1f6211eb6db1d8b4f761b467.png[/img]

Since the game's release, we've received a lot of enthusiastic feedback from players. One piece of feedback mentioned that the protagonist's 'gift' never got delivered in the end, which felt a bit pity. To make up for this, we've added a small scene in the ending where you choose to [spoiler]join OWL[/spoiler]. We hope this will bring you happy.

In addition to this update, we also plan to release some small content updates in the future. However, we can't reveal too much just yet, so please stay tuned.

Cheers!

notes.title: Minds Beneath Us Demo Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40422901/a21d38a11ad30b961a6fca55a5c78fbb6bb1a9e8.png[/img]


Hello everyone! It's the end of the year today, and we all survived another challenging year!
After a year of development of [i]Minds Beneath Us[/i], the demo of our game has finally been released!

[previewyoutube=OKI49w1cUY8;full][/previewyoutube]
This is a near-future science fiction text-based adventure game. Your choice will affect the story&characters, try it out now!
And if you like it please wishlist it, thanks!


[u][h3]Notes for the demo[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*]The dialogue options in this game are divided into [b]limited-time[/b] and [b]non-limited-time[/b], 
 but the UI design is not made clearly distinguishable, so you may need to pay more attention to them.
[*]If you encounter any bugs in the demo that cause the game to be unplayable, 
you can press [b]ESC[/b] and click the[b] [Restart Level][/b] option in the upper left corner of the screen.
[*]This demo [b]does not have an save/load function yet[/b], so it is recommended to finish the game in one go (game length is about 30-60 minutes). You can also skip levels by pressing [b]F9[/b].
[/list]

Lastly, we wish you all a happy New Year and all the best!

[u]#If you find any problems in the demo, please feel free to leave your comments in the feedback section of the forum.[/u]
